family_rules.name: case-insensitive-collation
family_rules.scope: public-fixture only; ASE evidence not promoted
family_rules.source_requirement: Declare SQL Server collation and PG normalization/collation; include uniqueness.

family_rules.name: trailing-space-comparison
family_rules.scope: public-fixture only; ASE evidence not promoted
family_rules.source_requirement: Compare SQL Server padding rules separately for equality, LIKE and binary collations.

family_rules.name: len-trailing-spaces
family_rules.scope: public-fixture only; ASE evidence not promoted
family_rules.source_requirement: LEN excludes trailing U+0020; preserve leading/internal spaces and NULL.

family_rules.name: integer-division-and-precedence
family_rules.scope: public-fixture only; ASE evidence not promoted
family_rules.source_requirement: Check SQL Server integer division and precedence; do not promote integers implicitly.

family_rules.name: isnull-first-type
family_rules.scope: public-fixture only; ASE evidence not promoted
family_rules.source_requirement: First-argument type/length drives SQL Server ISNULL truncation; ASE is not authority.

family_rules.name: empty-string-cast
family_rules.scope: public-fixture only; ASE evidence not promoted
family_rules.source_requirement: SQL Server empty numeric/date conversion differs from both ASE storage and PG casts.

family_rules.name: datetime-rounding
family_rules.scope: public-fixture only; ASE evidence not promoted
family_rules.source_requirement: SQL Server datetime grid, range and displayed milliseconds require separate observations.

family_rules.name: datediff-boundaries
family_rules.scope: public-fixture only; ASE evidence not promoted
family_rules.source_requirement: SQL Server counts unit boundaries rather than whole elapsed units.

family_rules.name: session-date-settings
family_rules.scope: public-fixture only; ASE evidence not promoted
family_rules.source_requirement: Bind DATEFIRST, DATEFORMAT and conversion styles; don't reuse ASE defaults.

family_rules.name: round-and-money
family_rules.scope: public-fixture only; ASE evidence not promoted
family_rules.source_requirement: Check signed ties, negative scales and money intermediate precision on SQL Server.

family_rules.name: catch-side-effects
family_rules.scope: public-fixture only; ASE evidence not promoted
family_rules.source_requirement: SQL Server caught statement failure need not roll back prior work; PG EXCEPTION subtransaction does.

family_rules.name: transaction-state
family_rules.scope: public-fixture only; ASE evidence not promoted
family_rules.source_requirement: Bind XACT_ABORT and entry/exit @@TRANCOUNT; no wrapper rollback.

family_rules.name: informational-raiserror
family_rules.scope: public-fixture only; ASE evidence not promoted
family_rules.source_requirement: Severity <=10 is informational; approved message/error mapping required.

family_rules.name: identity-and-triggers
family_rules.scope: public-fixture only; ASE evidence not promoted
family_rules.source_requirement: SCOPE_IDENTITY differs from @@IDENTITY with triggers; sequences also advance on rollback.

family_rules.name: rowcount-lifetime
family_rules.scope: public-fixture only; ASE evidence not promoted
family_rules.source_requirement: @@ROWCOUNT changes after intervening statements; capture DONE_IN_PROC separately.

family_rules.name: multiple-result-sets
family_rules.scope: public-fixture only; ASE evidence not promoted
family_rules.source_requirement: Explicit map between ordered TDS result sets and PG refcursors/OUT sets.

family_rules.name: output-and-return
family_rules.scope: public-fixture only; ASE evidence not promoted
family_rules.source_requirement: Capture OUTPUT values and default return 0 independently of result sets.

family_rules.name: update-from-ambiguity
family_rules.scope: public-fixture only; ASE evidence not promoted
family_rules.source_requirement: Several matching update sources leave the selected row unspecified; policy/repeated-run required.

family_rules.name: merge
family_rules.scope: public-fixture only; ASE evidence not promoted
family_rules.source_requirement: Qualify matched/unmatched effects and duplicate-source errors on exact engine versions.

family_rules.name: temporary-object-scope
family_rules.scope: public-fixture only; ASE evidence not promoted
family_rules.source_requirement: Local procedure temp scope and table variables differ from persistent PG session temp tables.

family_rules.name: dynamic-sql-binding
family_rules.scope: public-fixture only; ASE evidence not promoted
family_rules.source_requirement: Inventory-only ASE unsupported status does not establish SQL Server support; preserve parameter binding.

family_rules.name: cursor-fetch-status
family_rules.scope: public-fixture only; ASE evidence not promoted
family_rules.source_requirement: @@FETCH_STATUS is connection-scoped and can be changed by nested cursors.

family_rules.name: set-based-triggers
family_rules.scope: public-fixture only; ASE evidence not promoted
family_rules.source_requirement: Multirow inserted/deleted facts must match statement semantics, not per-row assumptions.

family_rules.name: bit-and-uuid
family_rules.scope: public-fixture only; ASE evidence not promoted
family_rules.source_requirement: SQL Server bit/uniqueidentifier are not ASE timestamp rowversions; explicit canonical types.

family_rules.name: unordered-top
family_rules.scope: public-fixture only; ASE evidence not promoted
family_rules.source_requirement: TOP without ORDER BY always requires a policy; a coincidental matching row is not equivalence.

pending_decisions: error equivalence if both engines error
